# The lanes, one by one

What each lane runs, when, which settings and secrets it reads, and what the
check-in may run for it. [LANES.md](../LANES.md) says what each lane does in
plain words; [lane-manifest.md](lane-manifest.md) explains the manifest this
page is generated from. A box runs every lane unless `FLEET_LANES` names
only some of them, by the names below. Secrets are never in a settings
file: store each with `sudo cti-agent-secrets set NAME`. A lane that needs
more than this to run has an operating guide in [lanes/](lanes/).

| Lane | What it is | Units |
|---|---|---|
| [`checkin`](#checkin) | The orchestrator's heartbeat: one /checkin beat of the Claude Code agent that watches the other lanes. | checkin, credcheck |
| [`digest`](#digest) | The daily threat-intel digest: read the CTI mail, enrich every CVE with exposure on our hosts, and send the brief; on Mondays, the weekly rollup. | digest, weekly |
| [`scout`](#scout) | Poll advisory feeds for CVEs the mail has not mentioned yet, to feed the digest. | scout |
| [`patchtuesday`](#patchtuesday) | The monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday synopsis, with exposure on our hosts. Run by hand for now; its timer is off on purpose. | patchtuesday |
| [`appscan`](#appscan) | The weekly application-security report from the web app scanner's results, with Jira tickets per application. | appscan, appaudit |
| [`appowners`](#appowners) | Each application's scan report, sent to its owners the morning after the scan. | appowners |
| [`domains`](#domains) | The weekly domains check: registrar, DNS, web and mail records, plus one Jira ticket for IT. | domains |
| [`vmscan`](#vmscan) | The weekly VM scan report: which scheduled scans ran, and which networks in the network sheet no scan reached. | vmscan |
| [`supplier`](#supplier) | Supplier requests from the supplier mailbox, judged for third-party risk, with Jira Kanban items. | supplier |
| [`mailbox`](#mailbox) | Mailbox housekeeping: file processed advisories away after the digest has read them. | mailbox |

## checkin

The orchestrator's heartbeat: one /checkin beat of the Claude Code agent that watches the other lanes.

- **Not in the orchestrator's lane table:** it is the orchestrator's own lane.

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-checkin` | `run-checkin --for-real` | 5min after boot, then every 2h | 30 min |
| `cti-agent-credcheck` | `run-credcheck` | `*-*-* 05:30:00`, catches up after downtime | 15 min |

- **Settings:** loads every lane's file, since it oversees them all.
- **Settings in `fleet.d/checkin.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `CHECKIN_CREDCHECK_TIMEOUT`, `CHECKIN_MAX_ALERTS`, `CHECKIN_MAX_BASH`, `CHECKIN_MAX_BOARD_GROWTH`, `CHECKIN_MAX_BOARD_WRITES`, `CHECKIN_MAX_DB_WRITES`, `CHECKIN_MODEL`, `CHECKIN_TRACE_MAX_MB`, `FLEET_BUDGET_BACKOFF_BASE_HOURS`, `FLEET_BUDGET_BACKOFF_MAX_HOURS`, `FLEET_BUDGET_DAILY_BEATS`, `FLEET_BUDGET_FILE`, `FLEET_BUDGET_WINDOW_BEATS`, `FLEET_BUDGET_WINDOW_HOURS`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `CHECKIN_`, `FLEET_BUDGET_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Credential check,** daily by `run-credcheck`: `cti-mailer --check`, `cti-jira --check`
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: run-credcheck's report becomes the check-in lane's health report).
- **The check-in may run:** `Bash(fleet-board say:*)`, `Bash(fleet-board read:*)`, `Bash(fleet-board tail:*)`, `Bash(fleet-board resolve:*)`, `Bash(fleet-board expire:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db recent:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db findings:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db was-sent:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db rollup:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db remember:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db task:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db mail:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db ack:*)`, `Bash(fleet-db vacuum:*)`, `Bash(cti-budget status:*)`, `Bash(cti-kev:*)`, `Bash(fleet-timers:*)`, `Bash(cti-alert:*)`, `Bash(fleet-journal:*)`, `Read(reports/**)`, `Read(logs/**)`, `Read(archive/**)`

## digest

The daily threat-intel digest: read the CTI mail, enrich every CVE with exposure on our hosts, and send the brief; on Mondays, the weekly rollup.

- **Handles** on the board: `@ingest`, `@enrich`, `@brief`
- **Sends to:** `$DIGEST_TO`

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-digest` | `run-digest daily --for-real` | `*-*-* 06:00:00`, catches up after downtime | 60 min |
| `cti-agent-weekly` | `run-digest weekly --for-real` | `Mon *-*-* 07:00:00`, catches up after downtime | 60 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/digest.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `TRIAGE_BLIND_SPOTS`, `TRIAGE_ENABLED`, `TRIAGE_JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS`, `TRIAGE_JUDGE_MODEL`, `TRIAGE_MAX_PER_RUN`, `TRIAGE_MODEL`, `TRIAGE_READER_INSTRUCTIONS`, `TRIAGE_SENDERS`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `DIGEST_CC`, `DIGEST_SKIP_SUBJECTS`, `VM_ALLOW_TO`, `FLEET_ALLOW_TO`, `TRIAGE_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `FALCON_BASE_URL`, `FALCON_CLIENT_ID`, `FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `REPORT_REDACTION_SALT`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: the advisory mail read and the CVEs the scanner could not map).

## scout

Poll advisory feeds for CVEs the mail has not mentioned yet, to feed the digest.

- **Handles** on the board: `@scout`
- **Sends to:** nobody: feeds the digest

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-scout` | `cti-scout --feeds /etc/cti-agent/feeds.txt --out /var/lib/cti-agent/state/scout-latest.json --days 3` | `*-*-* 00,04,08,12,16,20:15:00`, catches up after downtime | 15 min |

- **Settings:** none of its own; the shared ones in `00-core.env`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** none.
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: the feeds that have gone silent).

## patchtuesday

The monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday synopsis, with exposure on our hosts. Run by hand for now; its timer is off on purpose.

- **Handles** on the board: `@patchtuesday`
- **Sends to:** `$DIGEST_TO`

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-patchtuesday` | `run-patchtuesday --for-real` | `Wed *-*-09..15 07:30:00`, catches up after downtime | 30 min |

- **Settings:** none of its own; the shared ones in `00-core.env`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: a month whose synopsis was not sent).

## appscan

The weekly application-security report from the web app scanner's results, with Jira tickets per application.

- **Handles** on the board: `@appscan`
- **Sends to:** `$WAS_TO`

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-appscan` | `run-appscan --for-real` | `Fri *-*-* 07:30:00`, catches up after downtime | 60 min |
| `cti-agent-appaudit` | `run-appaudit` | `*-*-* 08:30:00`, catches up after downtime | 15 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/appscan.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `WAS_ATTACH_REPORT`, `WAS_TICKETS`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `WAS_`, `APPSCAN_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Credential check,** daily by `run-credcheck`: `cti-appreport --check`
- **Health report:** `reports/health/appscan.json`, written by `cti-agent-appaudit`, stale after 26h; gap kinds `not_scanned`, `pending`, `held`, `no_owner`, `unconfirmed`, `incomplete`, `login_failed`, `unreachable`.

## appowners

Each application's scan report, sent to its owners the morning after the scan.

- **Handles** on the board: `@appowners`
- **Sends to:** each application's owners and watchers

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-appowners` | `run-appowners --for-real` | `*-*-* 07:15:00`, catches up after downtime | 60 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/appowners.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `WAS_OWNER_CC`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `WAS_OWNER_CC`, `OWNER_ALLOW_DOMAINS`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Health report:** none yet (covered by the appscan lane's health report: its audit lists each web app's last owner report).

## domains

- **Handles** on the board: `@domains`
- **Sends to:** `$DOM_TO`, plus one Jira ticket for IT

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-domains` | `run-domains --for-real` | `Tue *-*-* 08:00:00`, catches up after downtime | 60 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/domains.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `DOMAINS_DMARC_RUA`, `DOMAINS_DNS_SERVERS`, `DOMAINS_FILE`, `DOMAINS_GATEWAY_DAYS`, `DOMAINS_MAIL_GATEWAY`, `DOMAINS_REGISTRAR`, `DOMAINS_SMTP_PORT`, `DOM_ALLOW_TO`, `DOM_TO`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `DOMAINS_`, `DOM_`, `PROOFPOINT_POD_`, `JIRA_DOMAINS_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `GODADDY_PAT`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `POD_API_TOKEN`, `POD_CLUSTER_ID`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Credential check,** daily by `run-credcheck`: `cti-domains --check`
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: the domains in domains.txt the weekly check could not reach).

- **Handles** on the board: `@vmscan`
- **Sends to:** `$VMSCAN_TO`, plus one Jira ticket of spreadsheet fixes for the help desk

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-vmscan` | `run-vmscan --for-real` | `Mon *-*-* 08:00:00`, catches up after downtime | 15 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/vmscan.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `NETNOTES_FILE`, `NETRULES_FILE`, `SUBNETS_DRIVE_ID`, `SUBNETS_ITEM_ID`, `SUBNETS_SHEET`, `VMSCAN_ALLOW_TO`, `VMSCAN_EXTRA_LABELS`, `VMSCAN_GAP_TEAMS`, `VMSCAN_TO`, `VMSCAN_USER_OCTET`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `VMSCAN_`, `NETNOTES_`, `NETRULES_`, `SUBNETS_`, `JIRA_VMSCAN_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `NVD_API_KEY`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
- **Credential check,** daily by `run-credcheck`: `cti-vmscan --check`
- **Health report:** none yet (planned for 2.1: scan schedules that did not launch, and networks no scan reaches).

## mailbox

Mailbox housekeeping: file processed advisories away after the digest has read them.

- **Handles** on the board: `@mailbox`
- **Sends to:** nobody: moves mail

| Unit | Runs | Schedule | Time limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cti-agent-mailbox` | `run-mailbox-cleanup --for-real` | `*-*-* 07:00:00` | 10 min |

- **Settings in `fleet.d/mailbox.env`** (with the shared ones in `00-core.env`): `FLEET_MAILBOX_BACKLOG_THRESHOLD`, `FLEET_MAILBOX_TIME`.
- **A new setting goes in that file** when its name starts with `MAILBOX_`, `FLEET_MAILBOX_`.
- **Secrets its programs read:** `CLIENT_ID`, `CLIENT_SECRET`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`, `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_CLOUD_ID`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `QUALYS_BASE_URL`, `QUALYS_PASSWORD`, `QUALYS_USERNAME`, `TENANT_ID`.
